2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Denver’s rush gets a direct shot at Kansas City’s weakened blind-side protection
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City expects Patrick Mahomes to start, but left tackle Josh Simmons is out and the Chiefs may have to protect his blind side with a replacement against a healthy Denver front. Mahomes is also returning from last season’s knee injury, raising the value of clean early downs and quick-game answers. Denver brings Bo Nix back into meaningful action with a healthier supporting cast. The matchup centers on whether the Broncos can force obvious passing situations and make Kansas City’s tackle issue decisive before Mahomes can dictate tempo.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Denver’s clearest leverage comes from stressing Kansas City’s replacement tackle, while the Chiefs need efficient early downs and quick answers to keep Mahomes out of predictable pressure situations.
